x: In a one-hour Track Walk at Austin (Texas) in November, the winner was John Knifton with a distance of 7 miles 1698 yards, some three quarters of a mile ahead of the second man. At South Croydon on February 7th our U/20s team of Steven Marshall, Mike Nicholls and Andrew Dorman were 2nd team in the S.W.C.
